dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the 2D profile from the maximum width of the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth lateral margins with a subtle localized indentation on the posterior-right edge where the body meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey baseline intensity across the dorsal surface, with moderate specular highlights near the blowhole and anterior edges.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-contrast darker grey patches distributed across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, soft-edge transitions between localized darker pigmented regions and the primary grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single distinct, dark linear mark of high contrast located on the right posterior dorsal-lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: One longitudinal dark linear scar or rake mark visible on the right side of the posterior dorsal area.
